title: Spreadsheet with Formula Cells
description_html:
Implement a spreadsheet whose cells hold either an integer or a formula that refers to other cells.

Levels

  1. Part 1: values and formulas
    • set_cell(cell_id, expr) where expr is an integer or a formula like "=A1+B2-5"
    • get_cell(cell_id) returns the evaluated value
  2. Part 2: fast reads
    • Make set_cell update every cell that depends on the changed one, so get_cell is O(1)
  3. Part 3: bad input
    • Detect a circular reference and reject it (e.g. raise "Circular reference detected")

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: OpenAI (Hello Interview question list, candidate reports); Harvey (spreadsheet-style coding per prep guides); Rippling (payroll formula-cell variant). Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
